en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al hassan Bin Kuleyb, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The laughter of the Momin is a smile’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from al-Hassan ibn Kulayb from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The laughing of a believing person is smiling.”
